conditions.genotype_support: engineered 4 founders, 27 full joint diploid genotype classes

exact_factorization: For i!=j, source outcross_ij = exported_i * (delivered_ij/exported_i) * (female_j/receipt_j). Zero paths remain zero. 3 Shapley components average all 6 factor orders; extra neutral-offspring-tilt-to-uniform-parent reference term is reported separately.
contrast_identity: Within-outcross source-minus-matched-null conditional offspring-frequency variance = -0.25*(1-source_self_fraction)*E[1/N|N>0,C]*(H_source_out-H_null_out). Four source-reference and Shapley components sum to this exactly at each parent state.
scientific_boundaries: The artificial mean-matched source-state null contains offspring-level assurance tilt, which contributes its own explicit reference term and is not biological pollen/maternal ecology.

The donor-export factor includes donor visitation affinity and discounting; visitor routing includes donor/recipient matching, visitor effectiveness and competition; maternal factor includes ovules, assurance preemption, and nonlinear pollen saturation.
Shapley averages factor ordering but is still baseline-dependent mathematical accounting, not uniquely causal donor, pollinator or maternal impact.
A negative within-outcross variance contrast does not imply autonomous whole-population variance stabilization; source viable-selfed offspring comprise about 93-96 percent at generation 8.

The source state distributions in these runs are generated by a different predetermined demographic stream than the earlier three-term audit; compare formulas and signs, not exact MC point equality across runs.
One old visitor environment and artificial founders, no independent ecology, no prospective confirmatory histories, no observed natural populations, no admitted Ito SDE/SPDE.
